annotations.title: Get add funds Coinbase (USDC) pay link

description:
Get a Coinbase checkout link, paid in USDC, that adds funds to the user's Atom account balance (the balance register_domain and purchase_domain pay from). The link supports the x402 protocol, so an agent with a crypto wallet (e.g. a Coinbase agentic wallet / x402 client) can pay it directly; a user can also open it in a browser. Use this when a balance purchase reports insufficient funds and the user wants to top up with crypto/USDC.

Always present the exact server-computed price returned here — never recompute it. This tool charges nothing by itself.

AFTER PAYMENT: call get_coinbase_payment_status with the returned payment_code — the funds are only credited once that reports status 'completed' (poll again while it reports 'pending'). Then retry the balance purchase.

amount.description: USD amount to add to the Atom account balance.

name: get_add_funds_coinbase_pay_link

checkout_url.description: Coinbase checkout URL (x402-payable). Hand to an x402 wallet or the user.

funds_amount.description: Amount that will be credited to the balance.
